title: Things to Do Before Completing Chapter 1 of GTA 6
description: Completing Chapter 1 of GTA 6 has major consequences. Make sure to prepare and check off important activities before hitting the point of no return.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Major Consequences of GTA 6 Chapter 1

As anticipation for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster continues to reach fever pitch, gaming media outlet GameRant has issued a timely reminder for players diving into *GTA 6*. Specifically, completing Chapter 1 of the game comes with some pretty major consequences, meaning players should take a step back before crossing the point of no return.

While open-world titles often use initial chapters to introduce mechanics and set up the overarching narrative, it appears that Chapter 1 of *GTA 6* holds a heavier weight than usual. Transitioning past this threshold is reported to alter the game world or narrative state significantly, potentially locking players out of certain early-game opportunities.

## Why You Should Pause Before Progressing

Before charging ahead with the main storyline and triggering the end of the opening chapter, players are advised to take stock of their current status. Failing to address certain activities beforehand could lead to missed content. While specific details of the consequences are framed around the transition itself, cautious players will want to ensure they have thoroughly explored what the opening phase has to offer.

*   Check your active tasks and early-game objectives.
*   Explore the available areas before narrative shifts occur.
*   Consider maintaining a separate save file if possible.

## Editor's Take

It is always exciting when a game enforces a true point of no return, as it raises the narrative stakes. However, it can also lead to FOMO (fear of missing out) for completionists. Taking a little extra time to wrap up loose ends in Chapter 1 is definitely a smart move before diving headfirst into the deeper chaos of *GTA 6*.
